<color=yellow>Oh, you found it! Great!</color> I lost that thing while I was trying to balance on a horse wearing roller skates during the <color=yellow>Great Scrap Skating Parade</color>. You ever seen a horse drift? No? Well, neither had I and now I owe the vet a lot of corn.

That peace sign has been my lucky charm since I traded it for three moldy beans and a hug back in '07. Please return it before I start hugging strangers for luck again. Things got weird last time..."

Adventurer, a cryptic riddle has been whispered through the winds of the Potato Festival, and none seem to know its true meaning. “Use the command... <color=yellow>/link...</color>” they say, but no one quite knows why. The elders of the land claim that this mysterious act will grant you access to the fabled <color=#738adb>Holy Discord Token</color>, an ancient relic connected to realms unknown (or maybe just <color=#738adb>Discord</color>). What happens when you link your account one thing’s for sure: a <color=#738adb>Discord Kit</color> awaits you upon completion.

Your mission is to unravel the mystery by using the command <color=yellow>/link</color> to connect your account to <color=#738adb>Discord</color>. You’ll receive the <color=#738adb>Holy Discord Token</color>, a relic you must return to me for your reward. What does it do? No one really knows. But it’s shiny, so it’s gotta be important, right?

Don't you think what nonsense!? In our world... Apparently, people from above have not left the city for a long time.

In general, find and recycle 20 Machetes.

As our settlement grows, so does the need for sturdy and reliable infrastructure. Recently, a heavy storm ravaged much of our lumber supply, severely hindering our ability to repair and expand our buildings. Our carpenters are skilled, but without enough wood, their hands are tied. We are thus issuing a call to all able-bodied gatherers and woodcutters to assist in restocking our vital resources.
